kurz: Loosen the browned residue on the bottom of the pan with liquid. It is full of roasted aromas and the best base for a sauce.
bild_im_kopf: Like a concentrate at the bottom of a cup that you dissolve again with water.
was_passiert: When searing, browned bits of protein and sugar stick to the bottom. They are pure [[maillard-reaktion|Maillard aromas]]. A liquid such as wine, stock or water dissolves them; reduced, they become a rich sauce.
typische_fehler: Black residue: burnt bits taste bitter and do not belong in the sauce.
schritte: Take the meat out of the pan and pour off excess fat.
Deglaze with wine, stock or water.
Loosen the residue from the bottom with a wooden spoon.
Reduce, and [[montieren|mount]] with butter if you like.
